verses.en: And it came to pass on the second sabbath after the first, that he went through the corn fields; and his disciples plucked the ears of corn, and did eat, rubbing them in their hands.
verses.sm: g O LE sapati e tuaoi ma le aso muamua, ua savali ai o ia i tosaito; ona ooti ai lea e ona soo o ‘au saito, ua mili ai i o latou lima, ma aai ai.

verses.en: And certain of the Pharisees said unto them, Why do ye that which is not lawful to do on the sabbath days?
verses.sm: Ona fai mai lea ia te i latou o isi o le au faresaio, Se a le mea tou te fai ai le mea e sa ona fai i le sapati ?

verses.en: And Jesus answering them said, Have ye not read so much as this, what David did, when himself was an hungred, and they which were with him;
verses.sm: Ua tali atu lesu, ua faapea atu ia te i latou, E lei faitau ea e outou le mea na faia e Tavita, ina ua fia ‘ai o ia, atoa ma lana au malaga;

verses.en: How he went into the house of God, and did take and eat the shewbread, and gave also to them that were with him; which it is not lawful to eat but for the priests alone?
verses.sm: ina ua ulu atu ia i le fale o le Atua, ma ua talia areto e laulauina i luma, ua ‘ai ai, ma avane i lana au malaga, e sa ona ‘ai ai, nana o le au faitaulaga lava ?

verses.en: And he said unto them, That the Son of man is Lord also of the sabbath.
verses.sm: Ua fetalai atu foi o ia ia te i latou, O le Atalii o le tagata, o le Alii lea o le sapati.

verses.en: And it came to pass also on another sabbath, that he entered into the synagogue and taught: and there was a man whose right hand was withered.
verses.sm: O le tasi sapati foi ua ulu ai o ia i le sunako, ma a‘oa‘o atu; sa i ai le tagata ua gase lona lima taumatau.

verses.en: And the scribes and Pharisees watched him, whether he would heal on the sabbath day; that they might find an accusation against him.
verses.sm: Ua lamalama ia te ia le au tusiupu ma le au faresaio, pe faamalolo e ia i le sapati, ina ia latou maua se mea e momoli ai o ia.

verses.en: But he knew their thoughts, and said to the man which had the withered hand, Rise up, and stand forth in the midst. And he arose and stood forth.
verses.sm: A ua silafia e ia lo latou manatunatu, oua fetalai atu lea i le tagata ua gase lona lima, Ina tulai ia, ma tu mai i totonu.

verses.en: Then said Jesus unto them, I will ask you one thing; Is it lawful on the sabbath days to do good, or to do evil? to save life, or to destroy it?
verses.sm: Ona tulai loa o ia, ua tu mai. Ona fetalai atu lea o Iesu ia te i latou, Ou te fesili atu ia te outou i le mea e tasi, Pe tatau ea i le sapati oua agalelei, pe agaleaga? po o le faaola, po o 3e fasioti ?

verses.en: And looking round about upon them all, he said unto the man, Stretch forth thy hand. And he did so: and his hand was restored whole as the other.
verses.sm: Ua silasila solo o ia ia te i latou uma, ona fetalai atu lea i le tagata, Ina faaloaloa ia lou lima ; ona faapea ai lea o ia; ona toe lelei ai lea o lona lima, c pei o le tasi.

verses.en: And they were filled with madness; and communed one with another what they might do to Jesus.
verses.sm: Ona matuā ita ai lea o i latou, ua fetautalatala‘i i se mea latou te faia ia Iesu.

verses.en: And it came to pass in those days, that he went out into a mountain to pray, and continued all night in prayer to God.
verses.sm: O aso lava ia ua maliu ae ai o ia i tatalo i le Atua.

verses.en: And when it was day, he called unto him his disciples: and of them he chose twelve, whom also he named apostles;
verses.sm: Ua ao foi, ona valaau atu lea o 'ia i ona soo, ua filifilia e ia ni o latou e toasefulu ma le toalua, ua faaigoa foi i latou e ia o aposetolo;

verses.en: Simon, (whom he also named Peter,) and Andrew his brother, James and John, Philip and Bartholomew,
verses.sm: o Simona, ua ia faaigoa atu foi ia te ia o Peteru, ma Aneterea lona uso, o lakopo ma loane,

verses.en: Matthew and Thomas, James the son of Alphaeus, and Simon called Zelotes,
verses.sm: o Filipo ma Patolomaio, o Mataio ma Toma,

verses.en: And Judas the brother of James, and Judas Iscariot, which also was the traitor.
verses.sm: o Iuta foi le uso o Iakopo ma Iuta le Sekara, o ia na avea ma le faalata.

verses.en: And he came down with them, and stood in the plain, and the company of his disciples, and a great multitude of people out of all Judaea and Jerusalem, and from the sea coast of Tyre and Sidon, which came to hear him, and to be healed of their diseases;
verses.sm: Ua maliu ifo o ia faatasi ma i latou, ona tu lea o ia i le mea laugatasi, ma ona soo e toatele, ma le motu o tagata e toatele mai Tutaia uma, ma Ierusalema, ma le itu i tai o Turo ma Saitonu, ua latou o mai e faalogologo ia te ia, ma ia faamaloloina o latou ta“;

verses.en: And they that were vexed with unclean spirits: and they were healed.
verses.sm: o e na tigaina foi i agaga leaga, ua faamaloloina foi i latou.

verses.en: And the whole multitude sought to touch him: for there went virtue out of him, and healed them all.
verses.sm: Ua tausisi le motu o tagata uma e pa‘i atu ia te ia ; auā ua alu ane ie mana nai ia te ia, ua faamaloloina ai i latou uma.

verses.en: And he lifted up his eyes on his disciples, and said, Blessed be ye poor: for your's is the kingdom of God.
verses.sm: Ua silasila atu ia i ona soo, ma fetalai atu, Amuia ontou e matitiva ; auā e o outou ie malo o le Atua.

verses.en: Blessed are ye that hunger now: for ye shall be filled. Blessed are ye that weep now: for ye shall laugh.
verses.sm: Amuia outou e fia aai nei; auā e maoona outou. Amuia outou e tagi nei; aua e featani outou.

verses.en: Blessed are ye, when men shall hate you, and when they shall separate you from their company, and shall reproach you, and cast out your name as evil, for the Son of man's sake.
verses.sm: Amuia outou pe a itagia outou e tagata, pe a faateaeseina foi outou, ma faaleagaina e i latou, ma lafoaiina lo outou igoa, pei o se mea leaga, ona o le Atalii o le tagata.

verses.en: Rejoice ye in that day, and leap for joy: for, behold, your reward is great in heaven: for in the like manner did their fathers unto the prophets.
verses.sm: Ia outou olioli i lea aso, ma ia outou osooso ma le fiafia ; auā faauta, o i le 3agi lo outou taui ua tele; auā sa faapea ona fai e o latou tamā i perofeta.

verses.en: But woe unto you that are rich! for ye have received your consolation.
verses.sm: A e peitai oi talofa ia te outou o e mauoa! auā ua outou maua lo outou lelei.

verses.en: Woe unto you that are full! for ye shall hunger. Woe unto you that laugh now! for ye shall mourn and weep.
verses.sm: “Oi talofa ia te outou e ua maoona! aua e fia aai outou. Oi talofa ia te outou o e featani nei! aua e faanoanoa outou, ma fetagisi.

verses.en: Woe unto you, when all men shall speak well of you! for so did their fathers to the false prophets.
verses.sm: auā e fia aai outou. 01 talofa ia te outou o e featani nei!

verses.en: But I say unto you which hear, Love your enemies, do good to them which hate you,
verses.sm: auā e faanoanoa outou, ma fetagisi.

verses.en: Bless them that curse you, and pray for them which despitefully use you.
verses.sm: ia outou faamanuia atu i e fetuu mai ia te 10 le uiga o le igoa Selote: o le loto malosi. owon, ia outou tatalo foi mo e tuua'i fua mai ia te outou.

verses.en: And unto him that smiteth thee on the one cheek offer also the other; and him that taketh away thy cloke forbid not to take thy coat also.
verses.sm: o le po ia te oe i le tasi alafau, ina liliu atu i ai le tasi; o le ave ese lou ofu tele, aua e te vaoia atu foi lou ofu tino.

verses.en: Give to every man that asketh of thee; and of him that taketh away thy goods ask them not again.
verses.sm: Ina avatu ia i tagata uma o e ole mai ia te oe ; o le fao i au mea, aua e te toe aamiina atu,

verses.en: And as ye would that men should do to you, do ye also to them likewise.
verses.sm: Pei ona outou loto i tagata ona ia latou faia ia te outou, ia faapea lava ona outou faia ia te i latou.

verses.en: For if ye love them which love you, what thank have ye? for sinners also love those that love them.
verses.sm: Pe afai tou te alofa atu i e alolofa mai ia te outou, pe se a ea se faafetai ia te outou i lea mea ? auā ua alolofa atu e agasala i e alolofa maila te i latou.

verses.en: And if ye do good to them which do good to you, what thank have ye? for sinners also do even the same.
verses.sm: Pe afai foi tou te agalelei atu i e agalelei mai ia te outou, se a ea se faafetai ia te outou i lea mea ? auā ua faia lea lava mea e ua agasala.

verses.en: And if ye lend to them of whom ye hope to receive, what thank have ye? for sinners also lend to sinners, to receive as much again.
verses.sm: Pe afai tou te avatu tupe i e nono mai, ma outou faamoemoe i ai e toe maua mai ai, se a ea se faafetai ia te outou i lea mea ? auā e avatu e tagata agasala tupe e nonoina e tagata agasala ina ia latou maua mai sona faatusa.

verses.en: But love ye your enemies, and do good, and lend, hoping for nothing again; and your reward shall be great, and ye shall be the children of the Highest: for he is kind unto the unthankful and to the evil.
verses.sm: Peitai outou, ia outou alolofa atu i e o fai outou mo latou fili, ma ia agalelei atu, ma ia avatu tupe e nonoina, aua le faamoemoe i se mea e tasi e au mai; e tele ai so outou totogi,. e avea foi outou ma fanau a le Silisili ese ; auā o ia le agamalu i e agavale, atoa ma e amio leaga.

verses.en: Be ye therefore merciful, as your Father also is merciful.
verses.sm: O lenei, ia mutimuti vale lo outou alofa, pei ona alofa mutimuti vale o lo outou Tamā.

verses.en: Judge not, and ye shall not be judged: condemn not, and ye shall not be condemned: forgive, and ye shall be forgiven:
verses.sm: Aua tou te faamasino atu, ona le faamasinoina mai ai lea o outou ; aua tou te faasala, ona le faasalaina mai ai lea o outou; ia outou faamagaloina atu, e faamagaloina mai ai outou.

verses.en: Give, and it shall be given unto you; good measure, pressed down, and shaken together, and running over, shall men give into your bosom. For with the same measure that ye mete withal it shall be measured to you again.
verses.sm: Ia outou foai atu, e foaiina mai ai ia te outou; e foai mai e i latou i lo outou lava ie pulupulu le fua lelei, e lolomi ma luluina, e tumu ma solo i tua. Auā o le fua tou te fuaina atu ai, e fuaina mai ai ia te outou.

verses.en: And he spake a parable unto them, Can the blind lead the blind? shall they not both fall into the ditch?
verses.sm: Ua fetalai atu ia le faataoto ia te i latou, E mafai ea le tauaso ona ta‘ita‘i i le tauaso? la te le pauu uma lava ea i le utu?

verses.en: The disciple is not above his master: but every one that is perfect shall be as his master.
verses.sm: E le sili le soo i lona a‘oa‘o, a ua taitasi ma faapei o lona a‘oa‘o o e ua atoatoa ona lelei.

verses.en: And why beholdest thou the mote that is in thy brother's eye, but perceivest not the beam that is in thine own eye?
verses.sm: Se a le mea e te vaai atu ai i si fasi laau i le mata o lou uso, a e le iloa e oe le utupoto i lou lava mata ?

verses.en: Either how canst thou say to thy brother, Brother, let me pull out the mote that is in thine eye, when thou thyself beholdest not the beam that is in thine own eye? Thou hypocrite, cast out first the beam out of thine own eye, and then shalt thou see clearly to pull out the mote that is in thy brother's eye.
verses.sm: Pe mafai faapefea ona e fai atu i lou uso, Lo‘u uso e, ina tuu mai ia so‘u eu ese le fasi laau i lou mata, a e le iloa e oe le utupoto i lou lava mata? O oe na le pepelo, ia e muai tiai le utupoto i lou mata, ona e iloa lelei ai lea e eu ese le fasi laau i le mata o lou uso.

verses.en: For a good tree bringeth not forth corrupt fruit; neither doth a corrupt tree bring forth good fruit.
verses.sm: E leai foi se laau lelei e fua mai i fua leaga; e leai foi se laau leaga e fua mai i fua lelei.

verses.en: For every tree is known by his own fruit. For of thorns men do not gather figs, nor of a bramble bush gather they grapes.
verses.sm: Auā o laau taitasi ma lona lava fua e iloa ai; auā e le tau e tagata fua o le mati i laau tuitui, latou te le tau foi se fuifui vine i le laau talatala.

verses.en: A good man out of the good treasure of his heart bringeth forth that which is good; and an evil man out of the evil treasure of his heart bringeth forth that which is evil: for of the abundance of the heart his mouth speaketh.
verses.sm: Ua au mai mea lelei e le tagata amio lelei i mea lelei ua teu i lona loto ; o le tagata amio leaga foi ua au mai e ia mea leaga i mea leaga ua teu i lona loto ; auā o le tele o mea i le loto e tautala mai ai lona gutu.

verses.en: And why call ye me, Lord, Lord, and do not the things which I say?
verses.sm: Se a ea le mea e ta‘ua ai a‘u e outou, Le Alii e, le Alii e, a e tou te le faia mea ou te fai atu ai?

verses.en: Whosoever cometh to me, and heareth my sayings, and doeth them, I will shew you to whom he is like:
verses.sm: O se sau ia te au ma faalogo i a‘u upu, ma faia e ia, ou te faailoa atu ia te outou le ua tusa i ai o ia.

verses.en: He is like a man which built an house, and digged deep, and laid the foundation on a rock: and when the flood arose, the stream beat vehemently upon that house, and could not shake it: for it was founded upon a rock.
verses.sm: E tusa ia ma le tagata ua fai lona fale, ua ia eli maulalo, ua tuu le faavae i luga o le papa; ona sau ai lea o le tafe, ua fafati mai le vaitafe i lea faie, ua le magaoioi ai lava; auā ua faavaeina i luga o le papa.

verses.en: But he that heareth, and doeth not, is like a man that without a foundation built an house upon the earth; against which the stream did beat vehemently, and immediately it fell; and the ruin of that house was great.
verses.sm: A o le faalogo, a e le faia, e tusa ia ma le tagata ua fai lona fale i luga o le eleele, e leai sona faavae ; ua fafati mai i ai le vaitafe, ona paū loa lea, fale. ona matuā nutipalaina lea o lea Ua faamalolo e lesu le auauna a le
